system: Floor Guard AI - Intelligent Multi-Hazard Floor Detection System
investigation_scope: End-to-end audit of model architecture, dataset annotations, inference pre/post-processing, confidence calibration, and frontend rendering

root_causes.evidence: ml/predict_image.py line 585: scaled_conf = round(0.950 + 0.046 * min(1.0, max(0.0, (conf_val - 0.10) / 0.90)), 4). A raw model probability of 0.22 was mathematically transformed into 0.956 (96%). In ml/predict_video.py line 211: scaled_conf = round(0.950 + 0.046 * ...) forced video frame predictions to >= 95%.
root_causes.impact: Unreliable confidence scores; low-confidence artifacts and noisy background detections were displayed as 98%-100% confident hazards.
root_causes.implemented_correction: Removed artificial scaling function. The system now reports genuine raw softmax/sigmoid model probabilities directly (e.g. 0.74 -> 74%). Scores between 0.35 and 0.60 are explicitly assigned 'Needs Review' status.

root_causes.issue: Oversized bounding boxes covering whole floor regions
root_causes.evidence: ml/predict_image.py line 632: pad_scale = 3.2 arbitrarily expanded bottle/debris boxes by over 320% of their actual radius. Multi-tile grid inference merged overlapping bounding boxes across quadrant seams without coordinate constraint, resulting in boxes encompassing 60%-90% of the entire image.
root_causes.impact: Bounding boxes engulfed clean floor areas, making detections appear unlocalized and inaccurate.
root_causes.implemented_correction: Disabled artificial coordinate expansion. Implemented direct inverse-letterbox transformation preserving the model's exact predicted coordinates. Non-maximum suppression (IoU 0.45) cleans multi-scale boxes without spatial dilation.

root_causes.issue: Cables and wires misclassified as obstacle debris or water spills
root_causes.evidence: In early training runs, thin linear cables had low pixel mass and were overwhelmed by obstacle_debris bounding boxes in multi-class images. In heuristic fallback, absence of high edge density redirected cables to water_spill.
root_causes.impact: Tripping hazards from power cords and trailing wires were incorrectly categorized.
root_causes.implemented_correction: Enforced dedicated cable_wire class training with augmented line-kernel features and strict Hough transform / dark linear edge verification in post-processing.

root_causes.issue: False hazard detections on clean reflective floors and normal stairs
root_causes.evidence: Dataset previously had insufficient hard-negative samples representing dry polished porcelain tiles with specular fluorescent light reflections and regular architectural stair steps.
root_causes.impact: Normal indoor flooring specularities were tagged as liquid spills or cracks.
root_causes.implemented_correction: Integrated dedicated negative baseline samples (clean polished tiles, dry grout lines, architectural staircases, safe floor mats) with 0 bounding boxes. Specular reflection filter requires contour liquid boundary verification before confirming water spills.

root_causes.issue: Small floor hazards receiving oversized or missed bounding boxes
root_causes.evidence: Input resizing to 512x512 with stride 32 downsampled small glass shards or bottle caps below feature map resolution (down to 16x16 feature grid).
root_causes.impact: Nails, small glass shards, and bottle caps either disappeared or were grouped into large surrounding floor boxes.
root_causes.implemented_correction: Preserved aspect ratio with centered letterboxing; calibrated minimum object detection threshold with localized high-resolution patch evaluation for small objects.

root_causes.evidence: Sparse keyframe sampling without tracking caused intermittent frame-by-frame class switching when lighting shifted.
root_causes.impact: Same continuous hazard logged as multiple distinct event types in video analysis.
root_causes.implemented_correction: Implemented temporal event consolidation with spatial IoU matching and keyframe smoothing, aggregating consecutive frames into unified hazard incidents.

verification_verdict: All root causes empirically verified on test frames and images. Model pipeline re-engineered for genuine probability reporting, tight localization, and hard-negative suppression.
